data.title: Test Board Meeting
data.description:
Here are some things you can try:

  1. Invite colleagues and anyone involved with your board to join you during this trial and then invite them to this meeting.
  2. Add to the existing sample agenda and board packet to see how simple and efficient Boardable is.
  3. Check out how the Member Meeting Page looks by exploring the expanded menu next to the Join Meeting button.
